affectedComponents: AICockpit sprint inspection and canonical relationship projection
expectedBehavior: Sprint inspection must return the same canonically assigned Tasks and Issues that Sprint-aware UI views display, using bounded relationship traversal.
observedBehavior: AgileCockpit Dashboard correctly displays SP-044 Tasks T-0185 through T-0189, but AICockpit sprint inspect SP-044 returns an empty workItems collection.
reproductionSteps: 1. Inspect SP-044 with AICockpit. 2. Observe empty workItems despite each of T-0185 through T-0189 having sprintID SP-044. 3. Open SP-044 in AgileCockpit Dashboard and observe the five Tasks.

workItem.title: Sprint inspection omits canonically assigned work items
